primary_score: median absolute fractional change in DESI-covered synthetic band flux
secondary_score: RMS of inverse-variance weighted residuals in 50-rest-Angstrom bins; flux normalized by saved per-galaxy scale
regularization: existing estimator: three inner holdouts select width and shrinkage; candidate quality cut applied at outer fit endpoint only
limitations: Artificial cutoffs do not reproduce physical DESI endpoint noise; no ground truth for missing u/y; reference is noisy measured data, not latent continuum; no NMF or visit-prior validation
selection: For each side and method, minimize validation median band-flux error; exact ties prefer lower threshold then fewer bins; final winning method selected separately per side using validation only
